scope: Public-source capital research for an early-stage Tennessee technology company. Program fit, applicant eligibility, current portal state and financing terms require separate verification.

routes.name: Customer-funded validation pilot
routes.summary: Use one paid, bounded validation engagement to test willingness to pay and produce a buyer-owned result.
requirements: Agreed scope, acceptance and payment terms
A result that can fail without changing the scoring rules
routes.next: Choose one workflow and ask the owner to define the incumbent baseline.
routes.limit: The existing $7,500 launch offer is proposed pricing, not buyer-tested revenue or an accepted contract.

routes.name: EC Impact Grants
routes.summary: A competitive, non-dilutive route linked to EC accelerator participation and founder presentations.
requirements: Current cohort rules and selection rubric
Current award amounts and due date
routes.next: Ask the facilitator for the Fall 2026 rubric, deadline and eligible use of funds.
routes.limit: EC pages show historical awards and differing prize descriptions. Do not use those figures as a confirmed current-round award.

routes.name: AssistTN / TSBDC
routes.summary: A route to legal, accounting and financial assistance for capital readiness. This is support, not a cash award.
requirements: Specific accounting, legal or financing question
routes.next: Prepare a one-page use-of-funds plan and ask which financial records a lender or investor would need.
routes.limit: Access and scope are provider-determined. No service acceptance is established.

routes.name: InvestTN
routes.summary: Tennessee venture investment for eligible, scalable companies. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
requirements: At least 1:1 qualifying private capital match
Cap table, commercial case and permitted use of proceeds
routes.next: Verify entity/location eligibility and identify a qualifying investor before designing the round.
routes.limit: Founder money, grants and loans are excluded from the matching co-investment described in the FAQ. Speculative activities are excluded; assess the actual business and use of proceeds. Equity dilutes ownership.
routes.timing: Rolling; matching capital within 120 days of conditional commitment

routes.name: LendTN / participating CDFIs
routes.summary: Tennessee business lending through participating community development financial institutions. Applications are rolling.
routes.next: Compare a relevant statewide lender's terms against a conservative monthly repayment scenario.
routes.limit: A program listing is not a loan offer, credit approval or interest-rate quote.

routes.name: SBA Microloan
routes.summary: Small loans through SBA intermediaries for uses such as working capital, supplies and equipment.
routes.next: Size the actual need and verify an approved intermediary serving the business location.
routes.limit: Maximum published term is seven years. Existing-debt repayment and real estate are excluded uses. Program maximum is not an approved amount.

routes.name: NSF America's Seed Fund
routes.summary: Project Pitch is the initial technology-fit route. The case must identify substantive technical R&D and a commercial opportunity.
requirements: Specific technical innovation and research risk
Current submission window and invitation rules
routes.next: Turn one falsifiable energy/performance experiment into a technical-risk statement; verify the live pitch window.
routes.limit: Routine engineering and a collection of features are not sufficient R&D justification. Invitation is not an award; no current submission window is asserted here.

routes.name: LaunchTN SBIR/STTR match
routes.summary: FY27 guidance describes a match of up to 50% of the federal award, capped at $100K for Phase I or $300K for Phase II.
requirements: Qualifying federal award and award notice
Winning proposal, use of funds and incorporation documents
routes.next: Verify a qualifying award before preparing a matching request; otherwise keep this as a later dependency.
routes.limit: The FY27 page lists October 5–16 and an award-notice eligibility window ending September 30, 2026. Confirm application year, cutoff time and any exceptions directly before acting.
routes.timing: FY27 page: October 5–16; confirm exact cutoff

session_questions: What milestone would make our next financing decision easier to underwrite?
For the current EC Impact Grant round, what are the rubric, deadline, award structure and permitted uses?
What evidence would an investor need to see before considering the private match required by InvestTN?
Which costs should be funded by customers, grants, equity or debt, and why?
Who can review our use-of-funds and repayment assumptions before we apply?
readiness: One specific use of funds and a costed milestone
Legal entity, ownership and location verified
Current cash and monthly cash-flow records
Customer problem supported by real interviews
Buyer-owned baseline and accepted pilot scope
Cap table and existing obligations reconciled
Program criteria and current deadline checked
Evidence-backed claims and relevant IP records
